title: Add a Pivot Table with Live Data in your Spreadsheet inside Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets)

chapters.title: Introduction to pivot tables with live data
Creating a new pivot table region
Configuring data source and pivot table fields
Completing the pivot table and viewing results
Interacting with live data and drilldown capability
Modifying pivot table structure and data reusability

features.name: Pivot tables with live data in spreadsheets
features.description: Create pivot tables within spreadsheets that display live data from Business Central. The pivot tables automatically refresh when opened and can be manually refreshed, providing dynamic data visualization based on real-time information.
caveats: Requires the advanced spreadsheets and reporting app

features.name: Pivot table field configuration
features.description: Configure pivot tables by selecting data source, defining row and column fields, and specifying aggregation values. Users can select date bucketing options (such as quarters) for date fields to organize data hierarchically.
caveats: Date bucketing options appear to depend on field type

features.name: Drilldown from pivot table to source data
features.description: Click on pivot table cells to drill down and view the underlying source records from Business Central. Users can control-click to access the original item ledger entries or other source data that composed the aggregated value.

features.name: Spreadsheet-based pivot table data reusability
features.description: Pivot table data remains as spreadsheet data that can be used as input for other spreadsheet calculations or analyses. Users can modify and manipulate the pivot table data within the spreadsheet environment.
caveats: Data manipulation depends on spreadsheet formula capabilities
